Copilot code review instructions

Markdown2HTMLTest is a test repository whose purpose is to convert Markdown to HTML via a GitHub Actions + pandoc pipeline. It has no application code, package manager, or test suite — most content is sample Markdown plus one workflow file.

What to review

  • .github/workflows/convertMarkdown.yml is the only executable logic. Check for:
    • Shell word-splitting or injection risks in the find | xargs | pandoc and rm pipelines. A filename with spaces already exists in this repo (新しいテキスト ドキュメント.txt); today it is not a *.md file so it only exercises the rm pipeline, but it would also exercise the pandoc pipeline if a future *.md path contained spaces.
    • Destructive steps: the workflow deletes all non-HTML files and force-pushes the release branch. Flag changes that could delete or overwrite unintended files or branches.
    • Action versions that are outdated or unpinned (e.g. actions/checkout).

What NOT to flag

  • Missing tests, linters, or package.json: this repository intentionally has none.
  • The Markdown files (test.md, folder/file.md) are deliberate GFM feature samples. Do not report their unusual constructs (placeholder ⋅ dots, intentionally malformed lists, raw HTML blocks such as the <dl> definition list, raw <b>/<em> tags) as bugs — they are test fixtures.
  • Generated *.html files and the release branch: these are build output, not source.
  • Non-ASCII filenames or Japanese text: expected in this repository.
